caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object centrally placed on a plain, off-white background. The object is bronze or brass in color and appears to be made of metal. It has two finger holes similar to those of a pair of scissors and a curved handle design. Attached to the handle is a rectangular box with a lid, featuring notched edges and sitting on three short, pointed legs. A thin, flat blade or spike extends from one side of the box. The metallic surfaces are highlighted with lighter shades to indicate reflective areas, and the object casts a faint, subtle shadow directly underneath. The artist’s signature, "SID. A. ROBERTS," is visible in small, brown-red lettering below and to the right of the object. The background is unadorned, emphasizing the details and form of the object.
title: Wick Trimmer
